title: Content Understanding: extract information from documents, forms and images
learningObjective: Extract information from documents, forms and images with Azure Content Understanding in Foundry Tools, using prebuilt and custom analyzers.
foundation: Content Understanding turns documents and images into structured data: the fields you care about, ready to store or search.
You choose an analyzer: a prebuilt one (for example prebuilt-invoice) or your own, where you list the fields you want.
Each result includes the values, a confidence score, and grounding that shows where each value came from.
engineer: Analyzers bundle extraction settings, a field schema and model deployments. Prebuilt document analyzers include prebuilt-invoice (vendor, totals, line items); prebuilt-imageSearch describes images for search. Custom analyzers define fields (name, type, description) with methods Extract (documents only; value as it appears), Classify (pick from categories) and Generate (create a value).
Documents and forms: OCR and layout (text, tables, selection marks, structure) produce markdown, then fields are extracted. Images: descriptions, detected text and generated or classified fields.
Portal: Foundry portal > Content Understanding: upload samples, choose or build a schema, test, review fields with confidence and grounding, then build the analyzer and copy its ID.

REST (GA api-version 2025-11-01): POST {endpoint}/contentunderstanding/analyzers/{analyzerId}:analyze?api-version=2025-11-01 with body {"inputs":[{"url":"https://..."}]} and a key or Entra token. 202 Accepted with Operation-Location; poll it until status Succeeded; read result.contents[].fields.
Quality: write clear field descriptions; use Classify for fixed categories; set confidence thresholds and route low-confidence values to human review.

animation.caption: Analyze documents and images with prebuilt and custom analyzers through the REST flow; choose the analyzer.

example.title: Accounts payable automation
body: A finance team runs supplier invoices through prebuilt-invoice and gets vendor name, invoice number, due date, total and line items with confidence scores.

For their own expense-claim form they build a custom analyzer: Extract claim_number, Classify expense_type (travel, meals, equipment), Generate a one-line justification summary from the attached receipt image.

prerequisites: An Azure subscription with access to Microsoft Foundry (ai.azure.com)
permissions: Azure AI User on the Foundry project to use models and agents; Azure AI Project Manager or Owner to create projects and deployments
limits: Analyzers and models are available in supported regions
Input file size and page limits apply per request
portal: Foundry portal > your project > Content Understanding: upload a sample file.
Pick a prebuilt analyzer or define a schema (field name, type, method Extract/Classify/Generate).
Test and review fields, confidence and grounding; then build the analyzer and copy its ID.

configuration.python:
# pip install requests
import os, time, requests

endpoint = os.environ["CU_ENDPOINT"].rstrip("/")  # https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com
headers = {"Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key": os.environ["CU_KEY"], "Content-Type": "application/json"}
url = f"{endpoint}/contentunderstanding/analyzers/prebuilt-invoice:analyze?api-version=2025-11-01"

resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json={"inputs": [{"url": "https://contoso.example/invoices/inv-1001.pdf"}]})
resp.raise_for_status()  # expect 202 Accepted
operation = resp.headers["Operation-Location"]

while True:
    result = requests.get(operation, headers=headers).json()
    if result["status"] in ("Succeeded", "Failed"):
        break
    time.sleep(2)

for name, field in result["result"]["contents"][0].get("fields", {}).items():
    print(name, field.get("valueString") or field.get("valueNumber") or field.get("valueDate"), field.get("confidence"))

steps: Content Understanding tab: analyze a document and an image; fix each error preset.
Choose a Content Understanding analyzer tab: answer every content type.
cleanup: If you ran it in Azure: az group delete --name rg-ai901 --yes (deletes the Foundry resource, projects and deployments).
lab.cost: Simulation: free. Optional real run: model tokens and Foundry Tools transactions are billed per use; delete the resource group afterwards.

troubleshooting.fix: Use the resource key header or an Entra token with the right role.

troubleshooting.symptom: Result has fields with low confidence.
troubleshooting.cause: Poor scan quality or vague field descriptions.
troubleshooting.fix: Improve descriptions or input quality; route to human review.

comparisons.difference: Content Understanding is multimodal with Extract/Classify/Generate; Document Intelligence focuses on document models.
Prebuilt for common types; custom for your own fields.

misconceptions.myth: Results come back immediately in the POST response.
Extract works on images and audio.
misconceptions.reality: Extract is for documents; use Generate or Classify otherwise.

architectureDecisions: Use confidence thresholds with human review.
